episodes.synopsis: Takeshi and Michi stay overnight at their school to study, where Takeshi picks up a card and Michi tells him that it comes from a game called Weiß Schwarz and that she has won many tournaments involving that game. Michi ends up getting sucked into a portal.
episodes.title: Heartfelt Card Game

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi enters the portal that Michi was sucked in and encounters the VS Ji-san. The VS Ji-san tells him he is in the Weiß Schwarz battle space and that he is the chosen warrior. Suddenly, a giant card battlefield appears with Michi standing on the other side, and Takeshi is told that in order for him and Michi to leave, he must become stronger by playing the game.
episodes.title: Heartfelt Feelings and an Old Man in the End of Nowhere

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi is given a deck to use against Michi, which VS Ji-san calls the "Great Galaxy Deck", or "GG Deck" for short. Takeshi ends up losing.
episodes.title: Heart Stopping First Experience

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi continues his training, but still ends up losing every time.
episodes.title: Training, Battle and the Excitements

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi, Michi and the VS Ji-san encounter new opponents.
episodes.title: Panting for Triple Moe

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi fights the three chaos sisters - Sies, Operetta and Cal. Takeshi manages to use a kick to peep under their clothing.
episodes.title: Panting for the Moe Kick

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi is down to level 3, but uses three cards to attack the girls. One of them contains Yu Narukami from Persona 4.
episodes.title: It`s a Fascinating *Boing* Pant Pant

episodes.synopsis: The three chaos sisters are finally defeated.
episodes.title: Here it Comes!

episodes.synopsis: Two new opponents appear in the third door, but they won't fight if there are girls around.
episodes.title: Welcome! Aristocrat x Cross

episodes.synopsis: Joe starts by summoning a weird monster, but the fight is interrupted when Michi leaves Takashi's pocket.
episodes.title: Figure and Aristocrat

episodes.synopsis: The fight between Takashi and Joe continues.
episodes.title: Metamorphic Aristocrat

episodes.synopsis: Coud takes over the fight, but is defeated.
episodes.title: Encore and Aristocrat

episodes.synopsis: Takashi prepares for battle against Michi, his final opponent.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The fight begins, but Takashi refuses to give up.
episodes.title: Clash!

episodes.synopsis: Takashi promises to take Michi back with him if he wins and uses Climatic Countdown.
episodes.title: Confession!

episodes.synopsis: Takashi and Michi are sent back to their own world, but Michi does not remember anything that happened there.
episodes.title: Return!
